title: ui/1: a server-driven screen document (CLIENT-UI-PLAN.md §5)
description: A tree of components from a closed vocabulary (§5.4), bindings into the app's live data and actions (§5.5). It is not a browser: no scripting, no layout maths, no styling beyond semantic tokens, so anything frame-rate, hardware or safety is a native component the screen only places by name. Unknown properties are allowed (§5.3: a newer server may add one and an older client ignores it), but an unknown component name is not: a component added later is a schema change, and until then the server sends a fallback. The transmit rule of §5.6 is enforced here, not only in code: no action anywhere in a document may declare level transmit (the 'not' in $defs/action), and the native ptt/enableTx components, which own transmit, may not carry a generic action at all. shack_ui's validator repeats both as named errors so a server author sees why rather than a schema path. plan §5.3 calls this file ui-screen.schema.json; it is ui.schema.json because it also holds the action shape overlay.schema.json uses.

ui.description: 1.x only; a breaking change is ui 2 and the server serves both for one release.

data.description: Feeds the screen binds to, all relative to the app's base: ws: an existing event socket, get: a JSON resource re-fetched on its feed's change event, or every poll seconds when given as an object.

relpath.description: Relative to the app's base: never absolute, never a scheme, because one process is served under a path prefix on one address and at a subdomain's root on another.

bind.description: A dotted path into the data feeds. No expressions.

format.description: A ShackFormat formatter (spec/vectors/i18n/format.json); numbers are formatted by the client.

allOf.description: ptt and enableTx carry transmit semantics in client code (lease, 1 s heartbeat, 5 s time-out, unkey on background); a generic action beside them would be a second, untested way to key.

not.description: §5.6: no generic action may transmit. Expressed as 'no action declares level transmit' rather than only 'no post does', because only post carries a level and a transmit level anywhere else is equally meaningless.
